marketplace.name: skill-market
marketplace.description: Marketplace for managing Claude, Codex, and Grok skills and plugins through local inventory, catalog discovery, lifecycle commands, and pull-request proposals.

packages.name: skill-market-claude
packages.description: Use this Claude plugin to list local Skill Market inventory, discover catalog packages, download, install, update, enable, disable, uninstall, and propose catalog changes through pull requests.

packages.name: complex-work-planning
packages.description: Use when explicitly requested; when complex implementation or architecture work is detected before coding, ask whether to start, then resolve user-owned decisions in stages, build a durable plan, and hand off only after review.

packages.name: parallel-tasks
packages.description: Use when the lead already has 2+ independent tasks or work tracks with disjoint write sets. Inventories dispatch capabilities, selects mechanisms that enforce resolved routing controls, obtains batch approval, then integrates and validates results.

packages.name: plantuml-diagrams
packages.description: Use when creating or updating source-backed PlantUML sequence, activity, component, flow, or architecture diagrams.

packages.name: project-engineering-foundation
packages.description: Use when creating a new AI-coding repository or conservatively inspecting and repairing an existing repo's durable engineering structure, including installable artifact build metadata, time-bucketed ref archives, and .ref draft handling.

packages.name: prompt-asset-improver
packages.description: Use before editing durable AI-facing prompt assets; confirms scope and proposed changes, refreshes inventory, backs up confirmed editable changes, keeps paired assets and related metadata aligned, and validates resources.
